items.title: The Field of a Charged Conducting Sphere (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: The Field of a Charged Conducting Sphere: a main subheading of 9.4 Gauss's law, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 200-201.

blocks.text: Radius R ka conducting sphere lein jis par charge q hai. Hum jaante hain ke saara charge sphere ki surface par barabar phaila hota hai (Fig. 9.15). Sphere har taraf se ek jaisa hai (spherical symmetry), is liye field har jagah radial (centre se seedha bahar) hai aur us ki magnitude (miqdar) sirf centre (beech ka point) se faasle r par depend karti hai. Yani conductor ke saath concentric kisi bhi sphere par E har jagah barabar hai. Is liye Gaussian surface ke liye radius r (R se bara) ka imaginary sphere lete hain.
Gaussian sphere ka area 4πr² hai aur us par E har jagah barabar hai, is liye poori surface se kul flux:

blocks.alt: Andar ka circle (conducting sphere, radius R cyan mein) jis ki surface par + charges, aur bara concentric circle (Gaussian sphere, radius r). Magenta lines dono se bahar radial, conductor ke andar dashed.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.15 (kitab ki Figure 9.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Conductor ka saara charge us ki surface par hota hai aur andar field zero hai; andar ki dashed lakeerein sirf yeh dikhati hain ke bahar field aisi hai jaise saara charge centre par ho. Radius r ka Gaussian sphere lene se E = q/(4πε₀r²) milta hai.
Yeh batata hai ke sphere ke bahar har point par field waisi hi hai jaise saara charge sphere ke centre par jama ho. Sphere ke bilkul bahar, jahan r = R:
Vector shakal mein r̂ field E ki direction (centre se bahar) batata hai.

blocks.caption: Gauss's law kaise lagayein (khulasa)

R se bare radius r ka concentric sphere

Flux ko (andar ka charge)/ε₀ ke barabar rakhein

blocks.prompt: Agar rubber ka charged ghubbara (balloon) gol ho aur charge us ki surface par barabar phaila ho, to kya andar E zaroor zero hai (constructed response 9.2)? Positive (musbat) charge q ki field mein ek be-charge conducting khokhla (hollow) sphere rakha hai; shell se kul (net) flux kitna hai (constructed response 9.4)?
blocks.explanation: Haan. Ghubbare ke andar banayi gayi gol Gaussian surface koi charge nahi gherti, is liye us se flux zero hai; aur symmetry ki wajah se E us poori surface par barabar hogi, is liye andar E khud zero honi chahiye. Be-charge shell se net flux zero hai: shell koi net charge nahi gherta, is liye jitni field lines andar aati hain utni hi bahar nikal jati hain.

items: Gauss's law: φₑ = Q/ε₀ (9.14); kisi band surface se kul flux andar band charge ka 1/ε₀ guna.
Gaussian surface: us point se guzarne wali imaginary band surface jahan field nikalni ho.
Charged conducting sphere: charge surface par; bahar E = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²), jaise charge centre par ho; bilkul bahar E = (1/4πε₀)(q/R²) (9.15).
